main_text.p:
culum iniquitatis. In malis promissis re- scinde fidem, &c. Ratio est: Quia omne illicitum est contra officium; Obligatio autem omnis est ad officium. Praeterea quicquid est illicitum, est aliquo modo a Deo prohibitum, (aut immediate, aut per consequentiam;) prohibitio autem Dei obligat ad non faciendum id quod prohibitum est, quam obligationem ex[?] tertia hypothesi subsequens Juramentum tollere non potest. Imo qui juravit facere id quod sine peccato fieri nequit, tantum abest ut obligetur ad id faciendum, ut potius obligetur omnino ad non faciendum. At juratum non adimplere perjurium est, inquies. Imo vero si res sit illicita in quam juratum est, tunc pejerasti cum jurasti: non pejeras, cum contra facis. Et rem illicitam ideo adimplere quia juravisti, nihil aliud est quàm perjurio flagitium adjicere velut [illegible, ~9 letters]
[illegible, ~8 letters]
[illegible, ~7 letters] Philo.Pelion Offa, & siti ebrietatem; quàm juramenti vice perjurii potius mensurar[?]um implere; quàm in perjurio obdurate sine pœnitentia perseverare.
Note: the scan is clipped at the right edge; the words cut there are marked [?]. The Greek note in the left margin could not be read.

page.notes: The right edge of the scan is clipped; words ending there are partly missing and are marked [?]. The Greek marginal note (three lines, with "Philo." beneath) is too faint to read letter by letter and is marked illegible. "Offa" is as printed and may be a printing error for "Ossa". "siti" is printed with a long s that looks like f; it is copied as siti. The catchword "SEC:" is letter-spaced in the scan and may be an abbreviation of "Sectio". The show-through and the neighbouring page edge at the right are not transcribed.
